meta.title: Ondra WeChat Channel (Official Account)
meta.description: The WeChat Official Account channel: the callback route mounts on the host webServer (no port of its own), sha1 signature verification, 800-character chunking, a 5-second hard limit answered first with a fallback line, and the real reply delivered through customer-service messages within the 48-hour window. A timeout does not abandon the turn — it changes the exit.
